value.text: Reward for inviting Escoffier to a duel at The Cat's Tail and claiming victory in a Friendly Fracas with her

value.name: Escoffier
value.desc: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 1</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, summons</color> <color=#ffffff>Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deals 1</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, heals all your characters for 2 HP.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Passive Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Passive) When battle begins, create 1</color> <color=#ffffff>All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>

<color=#ffd780>Support Card</color>
<color=#ffffff>Upon triggering</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo-Related Reactions</color> <color=#ffffff>by any side:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Randomly create 1</color> <color=#ffffff>Gilded Hall</color> <color=#ffffffa6>,</color> <color=#ffffff>Autumn Frost</color> <color=#ffffffa6>,</color> <color=#ffffff>Wave-Kissed Sands</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, or</color> <color=#ffffff>Verdant Gift</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and add it to your Hand.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 2</color>

<color=#ffd780>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>During this Round, the target character deals +2 DMG the next time.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(A character can consume at most 1 Food per Round)</color>

<color=#ffd780>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Heal the target character for 1 HP, and the target character gains 1 additional Max HP.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(A character can consume at most 1 Food per Round)</color>

<color=#ffd780>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>All of your characters gain</color> <color=#ffffff>Satiated</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and spend 1 fewer Elemental Die when using their Skill next time.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(A character can consume at most 1 Food per Round)</color>

<color=#ffd780>Event Card</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>All of your characters gain</color> <color=#ffffff>Satiated</color> <color=#ffffffa6>and deal +1 DMG the next time.</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(A character can consume at most 1 Food per Round)</color>

Applies Cryo and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Melt</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Superconduct</color> : DMG+1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Frozen</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives Physical or Pyro DMG, in which case they will take +2 DMG)

<color=#ece5d8>Physical DMG</color>
Physical DMG will not apply any Elements, nor can it engage in Elemental Reactions.
<color=#ece5d8>Usage(s)</color>
After this card's effect is triggered, 1 <color=#ffffff>Usage</color> of it will be consumed.
This card will be discarded immediately once it has 0 <color=#ffffff>Usages</color> remaining.
<color=#99ffff>Cryo-Related Reactions</color>
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Frozen:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Deals +1 DMG for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives Physical or Pyro DMG, in which case they will take +2 DMG)</color>
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Melt:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Deals +2 DMG for this instance.</color>
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Superconduct:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Deals +1 DMG for this instance, deals 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target.</color>
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80ffd7>Anemo</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffff>] Cryo Swirl:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Deals 1 Cryo DMG to all opposing characters except the target.</color>
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffff>] Cryo Crystallize:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points).</color>

customize.name: Lucky Coin
customize.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...
